question: Can the original pagecache tests execute under the fixed kernel's original QEMU harness before extending completion-contract checks?
source: git archive of fixed revision, extracted outside all existing repositories
config: platforms/kplat-x86_64/qemu_defconfig copied unchanged to isolated .config; make defconfig expands it
commands: make unittest UNITTEST_CRATE=pagecache ACCEL=n NET=n BLK=n VSOCK=n SMP=2 MEM=1g
classification: Configuration/build failure or timeout is not a test failure. Exit zero alone is not proof of tests executed: inspect named tests, selected count and summary in serial output. No pagecache cases means not exercised.
controls: No source patches, shared root config changes, dependency downloads or lockfile acceptance. Archive command logs and input/output lock hashes. Preserve unsuccessful attempt.
scope: Original tests only; no new rejected-budget assertion yet; no device durability or performance claims. Offline dependency failure triggers a separately recorded dependency diagnosis, not unrecorded environment repair.
